question: The following sentence has been divided into five segments. The first segment has no error. Select the option that has the segment with the grammatical error. It began / to rain / as soon as / she steps out of / the movie theatre.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence has an error in tense consistency. The past tense "began" should be followed by "stepped" instead of "steps".
 
• Using "steps" (present tense) after "began" (past tense) creates a grammatical inconsistency.
 
• The correct phrase should be "she stepped out of," ensuring both verbs are in the past tense.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.
